si_3_author_journal_year.answer: Sampaio et al., Artificial Intelligence In Medicine, 2025

si_4_title.answer: A generalizable normative deep autoencoder for brain morphological anomaly detection: application to the multi-site StratiBip dataset on bipolar disorder in an external validation framework

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Deep autoencoder (AE) trained on confounder-free features.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We used deep autoencoders in an anomaly detection framework... The model was trained with healthy control (HC) data... and applied to multi-site external data... We propose a normative model that integrates multivariate regionbased brain morphological data... and, for the first time, a confounders ' removal processing step

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness (CT) using DK40 atlas, Gray Matter Volume (GMV) and White Matter Volume (WMV) using CoBra atlas.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We propose a normative model that integrates multivariate regionbased brain morphological data: cortical thickness (CT), gray matter (GMV), and white matter volumes (WMV) features... regional cortical thickness measures for the Desikan-Killiany-Tourville (DK40) cortical atlas map... and regional tissue volumes for the CoBra volume atlas map
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Sampaio2025.pdf.md: Introduction; Materials and methods / sMRI pre-processing

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age, Sex, and Site effects were modeled/removed using M-ComBat and Linear Regression. TIV was used as a covariate for volume features.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: ComBat models biological covariates, such as age, sex, apriori, with a linear regression... assuming both additive and multiplicative site effects... For all feature sets, age and sex were included as biocovariates to preserve, while for volume features, previously harmonized TIV was also included.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Sampaio2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Confounder removal pipeline
